methods.what: Representation of a potential-type function as an integral over s with Δ = product of square roots (ellipsoid-type integral)
Substitution reducing the integral to an incomplete elliptic/hypergeometric-type integral in t with parameters x, y
Change of variables to logarithmic coordinates α, β with lmn constant
Chain rule converting derivatives with respect to log α, log β into derivatives with respect to x, y
methods.quote: $2\frac{\partial w}{\partial\log\alpha} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial\log\beta} = -2\alpha\frac{\partial w}{\partial y} + \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}(2\alpha x - \beta)$
